title: Law to require guidance on service animal access rights
summary: This bill would require the Department of Health and Mental Hygiene, along with the Commission on Human Rights and the Mayor's Office for People with Disabilities, to create public education materials and guidance on service animal access in places of public accommodation. The materials would explain what qualifies as a service animal, businesses' legal obligations and how to file complaints, and would include pamphlets and model signage. These materials must be posted online in multiple languages and accessible formats, and reviewed at least every three years.
